body: This 2026 Sprinter AWD 170 Extended in our El Capitan Tier is built for travelers who want maximum comfort, storage, power, and capability in a full-size adventure setup. It features an 800Ah Battle Born power system, 33 gallon water tank, tiled indoor shower, Laveo dry flush toilet, roof A/C, diesel heat, full kitchen, queen bed, smart TV, Starlink connectivity, extended range fuel tank, electric awning, upgraded suspension, winch, rear storage upgrades, and a rugged exterior package built for long road trips and off-grid travel.
